notes: I changed the shift rule: instead of only shifting ASCII a-z/A-Z with wraparound, the box shifts any Unicode alphabetic first character by +2 in codepoint (é→ë, ß→á, α→γ), per E6. I kept the ASCII wraparound behavior for a-z/A-Z since E2 showed z→b and Z→B, which codepoint+2 alone wouldn't produce — so ASCII letters wrap, other alphabetic chars shift by codepoint.
